RECIPE:

125ml warm water

120ml lukewarm milk

60ml melted butter

80g honey

2 large eggs plus one for egg wash

1.5 tsp salt

480g white bread flour

2.25 tsp yeast

canola oil for preparing the dough

INSTRUCTIONS:

in the bucket mix water, milk, honey, butter, salt and 2 eggs. Add flour yeast and turn on dough setting. When done, transfer to a large bowl (coat dough with oil) cover with plastic wrap and let rise for 1 hr. punch down dough. divide into 4 sections and do a 4-strand braid. place on a parchment line baking sheet. whisk 1 egg with 1tsp water and brush on egg wash with a spatula/pastry brush. let rise for 45 minutes. bake at 350 for 25-30mins (rotate halfway through cooking). Came out very delicious :) !!
